# TecScience

> TecScience is Tecnológico de Monterrey's platform for sharing scientific research, innovation, and educational content from its research centers and institutes.

TecScience aggregates research and divulgation content from multiple Tec institutes including the Institute for the Future of Education, Institute of Advanced Materials for Sustainable Manufacturing, Center for the Future of Cities, and specialized research centers. The platform serves as a knowledge hub for research archives, technology transfer, and science communication.

## Key Topics

- Tecnológico de Monterrey
- Research Centers
- Science Divulgation
- Business Innovation
- Technology Transfer
- Institute for the Future of Education

## Science Divulgation & Featured Content

- [Artículos de Divulgación Archives - TecScience](https://tecscience.tec.mx/blog/articulos-divulgacion): Science divulgation articles archive and research content index
- [Focus - TecScience](https://tecscience.tec.mx/blog/uncategorized/prueba-editoriales): Featured science divulgation content from Tecnológico de Monterrey institutes
- [La cornea y su función - TecScience](https://tecscience.tec.mx/blog/uncategorized/la-cornea): Medical education article on cornea anatomy and vision science

## Research Archives & Topics

- [Tecnología Archives - TecScience](https://tecscience.tec.mx/blog/tecnologia): Technology research archive covering advanced materials and biomedical innovations
- [Business Innovation Archives - TecScience](https://tecscience.tec.mx/blog/business-innovation): Archive of business innovation articles from TecScience and Tec research centers
- [Sustainability Archives - TecScience](https://tecscience.tec.mx/blog/sustainability): Sustainability research archive from Tec institutes and research centers

## Scientific Imaging & Specialized Research

- [Microscopia - TecScience](https://tecscience.tec.mx/blog/focus/microscopia): Scientific imaging article on microscopy and microphotography techniques
